source.title: Acres of Diamonds

source.corePromise: Train readers to spot value in the people, skills, and markets already around them.

titleConcepts: Built From the Ground Beneath You
subtitleOptions: A Modern Builder's Guide to Finding Wealth Where Others See Nothing
Why the Best Opportunity Is Usually Closer Than You Think
A Narrative Guide to Finding Real Markets Before You Chase New Ones
adaptation.modernWorld: Service businesses, overlooked local markets, creator ecosystems, logistics, home services, and ignored operational niches
toneRules: Write with human warmth, practical intelligence, and low-ego clarity.
Use grounded examples from local and online business without sounding like a lecture.
Keep the book story-led, energetic, and concrete.
prohibitedChanges: Do not imply the original author wrote this adaptation.
Do not detach the book from practical action.
Do not use real public figures or real company names.
coreLessons: Opportunity is often hidden in familiar ground.
Most people overlook value because familiarity makes them blind.
Disciplined observation turns ordinary markets into wealth.
The person willing to solve unglamorous problems sees value before the crowd does.
Most people chase glamour because they do not understand boring demand.
